evidence.note: Reuters documents reversed Oracle gains, increased credit risk and investor doubts about OpenAI financing during the target period.
The report documents substantial Oracle losses and financing anxiety spilling into other AI-linked stocks immediately before the post.
The survey records increased concern about AI capital expenditure and financing within the target period.
Nvidia's October record shows continued enthusiasm after September, limiting any interpretation of an immediate or uniform loss of confidence.
Overall market sentiment measures a broader target. Optimism about AI productivity can coexist with weakening confidence in infrastructure financing.

reviews.rationale: Under the fair contextual reading, price declines, credit concerns and surveys establish weakening confidence in the AI trade by early February. Nvidia's intermediate record and broader market bullishness limit the breadth and timing of that conclusion but do not overturn it. The incidental claim about Marcus's earlier label remains outside the contract.

The contract permits prices on or near the dates, so missing official closes do not prevent resolution. The intervening October peak means the path was uneven; it does not defeat the fair net-performance reading or establish anything about later prices.
